gen-gf-fontdiner-swanky-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab reads bookish and dignified, its open counters letting every word stretch out in the white space. Hepta Slab's wire-like strokes against Fontdiner Swanky's showy, shifting thickness make the strongest part of this pairing.
gen-gf-fontdiner-swanky-gf-stint-ultra-e: Authoritative letters from Stint Ultra Expanded float apart, each one a constant-walled ring or bar, while Fontdiner Swanky waves its flourishes overhead. Reading it would feel spacious and slow.
gen-gf-fragment-mono-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono reads modern and compact, its capitals melting into the lowercase like pins in a board. Fragment Mono earns its keep big and short, where its typewriter rhythm and wide curves get noticed.
gen-gf-fragment-mono-gf-julius-sans-one: Julius Sans One spreads its letters across wide gaps of blank space, with capitals and lowercase nearly level. And Fragment Mono's typewriter stride sits above it, so enlarge the body text if those gaps start to feel thin.
gen-gf-fragment-mono-gf-lexend-exa: Precise and technical, Fragment Mono lays out typewriter-width letters with short ascenders and gaping curves. But Lexend Exa does the heavier lifting for reading, with its big x-height and uniform line.
gen-gf-fragment-mono-gf-lexend-giga:
Lexend Giga reads flat and modern, with generous tracking.

Fragment Mono is the one to worry about if shrunk, since its short ascenders and typewriter widths get lost, whereas Lexend Giga stays clear at larger sizes.
gen-gf-fragment-mono-gf-lexend-mega: Approachable Lexend Mega draws every letter as if with one nib, its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals. And Fragment Mono's typewriter widths give that friendly body a precise, technical counterpart.
gen-gf-fragment-mono-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta reads professional and open, with a big x-height and curves that never thin out. Fragment Mono does its best work as the exacting, typewriter-spaced voice, while Lexend Peta carries the sentences.
gen-gf-fragment-mono-gf-lexend-tera: Contemporary and clean, Lexend Tera draws every letter with a plotter-pen line, spaced like stepping stones. But Fragment Mono is the one with typewriter precision, short ascenders and gaping curves in lowercase.
gen-gf-fragment-mono-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta reads approachable and widely tracked, with tall-bodied small letters in ribbon-like strokes. But if Fragment Mono were made small, its short ascenders and typewriter widths would fade, and a large Lexend Zetta would sprawl.
